rationale: The assistant correctly identified the hidden truth in a single turn: Eco 40-60 is deliberately long and low-temperature by design, so the machine is not faulty and should not be returned. It explained the energy-label rationale, matched the customer's own evidence, pointed to the TimeManager button and Cottons 40 as faster options, and gave sensible, bounded conditions under which a real fault would be suspected. It asked no explicit confirming question (e.g. whether other programmes run to normal time), which is the only minor gap; no fabrication, parts or unwarranted escalation.
